body_html:
Congratulations to our newly weds getting married at Della Terra Mountain Chateau. This venue is truly beautiful located in Estes Park. Although it may have been a Monday wedding, it definitely felt much more like a Saturday wedding, and was one of the most upbeat, fun, and exciting weddings so far this season that I have worked! It was a great night and we without a doubt had people dancing until the very last song!

DJ Cameron
